question: In a certain code language, STYLE is written as JBGCE. How will HOUND be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8179cbc1a1672f3331d5012c4235a07a83ca43459458411c9d77855cbaa9160.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, STYLE is written as JBGCE. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e85cb1a18e3ce8d3067a6cf212517dba5bc34d805ab5c4e31f78ccaebf03e22.png] 

Similarly, HOUND be written as ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b3b3eb7cc804eb70340e863e8498e171264d006b802ac2b7ed481b736ef41fc.png] 

Thus, HOUND be written as HFCED.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
